description: A melee spell attack against a creature you can reach: 3d10 necrotic damage on a hit (+1d10 per slot level above 1st).
higher_level: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d10 for each slot level above 1st.
srd_description: Make a melee spell attack against a creature you can reach. On a hit, the target takes 3d10 necrotic damage.
